metadata.summary: The top stories and transfer rumours from Thursday's newspapers...

messages.text: MI London's Hundred title defence over despite narrow win over Phoenix

metadata.summary: MI London had the lights turned out on their hopes of claiming a fourth straight Hundred title despite beating bottom-placed Birmingham Phoenix in a nip-and-tuck final men's group match.

messages.text: Rashford absent in Leeds friendly win but still part of Man Utd plans

metadata.summary: Joshua Zirkzee and Brenden Aaronson scored as Manchester United and old foes Leeds played out an entertaining 1-1 friendly draw at the spiritual home of Irish sport in Dublin, before the concluding shoot-out was edged 5-4 by Michael Carrick's side.

messages.text: Guimaraes makes bow and Lewis-Skelly scores as Arsenal held by Como

metadata.summary: Bruno Guimaraes made his first appearance and Myles Lewis-Skelly scored amid speculation about his future as Arsenal were held to a 1-1 draw by Como before winning 4-3 on penalties.

messages.text: Arteta: There's more we want to do in the transfer market

metadata.summary: Mikel Arteta says Arsenal are actively looking for more new signings in the transfer market but admits there is only a small pool of available players who can take them to the next level.

messages.text: Chelsea set Man City deadline to bid for Fernandez

metadata.summary: Chelsea have told Manchester City they have a deadline of 5pm this Friday to make an offer for Enzo Fernandez.

messages.text: Atletico agree deal to sign Spurs captain Romero

metadata.summary: Atletico Madrid have agreed a deal in principle with Tottenham to sign Cristian Romero.

messages.text: Doue silences Madjo-mania as PSG beat Villa to win Super Cup

metadata.summary: Desire Doue scored the winner as champions of Europe Paris Saint-Germain beat Aston Villa 2-1 to win the UEFA Super Cup.

Birmingham Phoenix win battle to avoid Hundred wooden spoon vs MI London

metadata.summary: Birmingham Phoenix prevailed in the battle to avoid the wooden spoon in The Hundred women's competition as Ellyse Perry's composed half-century condemned MI London to a sixth defeat of a chastening campaign.

metadata.summary: Cricket fans at Edgbaston were among sporting spectators given a stunning view of Wednesday evening's partial solar eclipse.

messages.text: O'Sullivan's poor start to season continues with early China Open loss

metadata.summary: Ronnie O'Sullivan's poor start to the new season continued after he lost 6-4 to Noppon Saengkham in the second round of the China Open.

messages.text: Everton breeze past lacklustre Newcastle in Murrayfield friendly

metadata.summary: Matthias Jaissle was given a hint of the task in hand as Newcastle boss as Premier League rivals Everton strolled to a comfortable 3-1 win in a pre-season friendly at Murrayfield.

messages.text: Chelsea stars for sale: The players who could leave - and what they'll cost

metadata.summary: Chelsea are the Premier League's top spenders this summer with the bulk of their business done and attention is now turning to sales.

messages.text: Fery feels 'no added pressure' despite being British No 1 as he returns

metadata.summary: Arthur Fery insists he feels “no added pressure” as the new British No 1 prepares to return to action this weekend for the first time since his memorable run to the Wimbledon semi-finals.

messages.text: McIlroy keen to asses his game during first FedExCup Playoffs event

metadata.summary: Rory McIlroy believes this week's FedEx St. Jude Championship will be a good chance for him to assess the current standard of his game, as the Northern Irishman returns to PGA Tour action for the first time since The Open.

messages.text: Cadillac sack team principal Lowdon as Budkowski takes charge

metadata.summary: Cadillac have sacked team principal Graeme Lowdon and replaced him with Marcin Budkowski in what Formula 1's 2026 newcomers claim is a "planned leadership transition".
